title: My muscles
examples: How do my muscles help me run fast?
Are my muscles strong enough to lift a big book?
Do I need to exercise to make my muscles big?

explain.say: Your muscles are joined to your bones. They pull on your bones.
A muscle pulls on a bone to bend your elbow.
When one muscle pulls, its partner muscle relaxes.
When you bend your arm, your bicep pulls. Your tricep relaxes.
When you walk, your leg muscles pull on your bones.

faq.q: Do I have to pull my bones to move?
faq.a: Your muscles do the pulling. Your bones move when your muscles pull them.
Muscles help you do almost everything, like sitting up or waving hello.
asks: What is the job of muscles?
What do muscles help me do?

faq.a: No, they usually work in pairs, one pulling while the other relaxes.
asks: Do I need two muscles to move?

faq.q: Is it true that muscles get tired?
faq.a: Yes, if you use them too much, they can feel tired, just like you can get tired.
asks: What happens when I use my muscles a lot?

faq.a: Your leg muscles are some of the biggest and strongest. Your jaw muscles can bite very hard too.
asks: Are some muscles stronger than others?

facts: Muscles are attached to bones by tough tissues called tendons.
When a muscle pulls, it gets shorter, which is called contracting.
Muscles often work as an opposing pair to create movement.
Exercise helps make your muscles strong and healthy.

quiz.say: You bend your arm at the elbow. Which muscle pulls?
quiz.show: 💪 Bend your arm. Which muscle pulls?
quiz.why: Your bicep is on the front of your arm. It pulls to bend your elbow.

wrong.0: Your tricep relaxes when you bend, and pulls when you straighten.
wrong.2: Bones move, and muscles do the pulling.

quiz.say: One muscle in a pair pulls. What does its partner do?
quiz.show: 💪 One pulls. What does the partner do?
quiz.why: One muscle pulls while its partner relaxes. Then your arm can move.

wrong.1: Two muscles pulling against each other would hold your arm still.
wrong.2: A tight partner would stop the arm from bending.

quiz.say: What is the main job of your muscles?

options.show: pull on bones to move you
options.say: pull on bones to move you

quiz.why: Muscles pull on your bones, and that moves your body.

wrong.0: Bones grow by themselves as you grow.
